Checks#

This page is for maintainers: how Booster is checked, and where its proof lives. Next: Next for what is not built yet.

Maintainers: how to build, test and release this project, and where its data comes from, is in MAINTAINING.md.

Checks: composer ci (the same command runs on GitLab and GitHub).

Development happens on git.wayne.edu (the canonical repository); this GitHub repository is a read-only push mirror of it. Changes land on git.wayne.edu first.

composer ci

runs composer validate --strict, PHPUnit, Pint, PHPStan (Pinstripe's raw preset, inlined; waynestate/pinstripe ships with Booster and supplies the preset the advisory scan uses), composer audit, the hop data check, the agent-ready check, the Real output page check (bin/build-proof.php --check) and the docs site check (composer docs:check). Nothing needs PHP on the host:

docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/app" -w /app composer:2.11.1@sha256:8de2184c6de224f4689e8f80ed5f5edaf0030b6b8b7839a22a2bcb6722ac87d0 sh -c "composer install --no-interaction && composer ci"

contract/expectations.json says what Booster must detect, plan and change for each example app in examples/; tests/ContractTest.php enforces it with the real Rector, so a Rector release that changes a hop shows up in CI.

Proof#

Proof runs against real Wayne State applications are on a private site, proof.apps.wayne.edu/booster, behind a Wayne State employee sign-in. The Real output page shows Booster's own plan and dry-run output on each example app, and composer ci keeps it current.

Proven how: the first full run with the gate on took a Laravel 12 app from PHP 8.2 to 8.4 in two hops, each gated by the app's 197-test suite, and it is written up in research/booster-e2e-gate.md.

The front-end hops (vite-major, tailwind-3-to-4, typescript-major, inertia-2-to-3) were proven on 2026-11-06 on a Laravel 12 app generated from the public Laravel Vue starter kit, with every gate on: the first pass found four bugs, each fixed with a test, and the upgraded app then built, passed its tests on PHP 8.5 and registered a user in a browser. The private proof site has the hop-by-hop table.

The same day, the whole chain ran on a copy of WELD's own site app with every gate and the replay gate on: PHP 8.3 to 8.5, PHPUnit 12 to 13 with Pest 4 to 5, Node 26, Vite 8, TypeScript 6 and Inertia 3, seven hops, ten recorded pages matching after each one. That run found eight more bugs, each fixed with a test and listed in the changelog.

Status#

See CHANGELOG.md for what changed, OPEN_QUESTIONS.md for what stays open, and BEST_PRACTICES.md for the rules Booster follows.
